name: wedhub
description: Root-level dev orchestration only — each project (wedhub-backend, wedhub-frontend-app, wedhub-website-builder) still has its own package.json and is deployed independently via ecosystem.config.js. This file exists solely so `npm run dev` can start the backend API, its BullMQ worker, and the frontend together — running the API alone leaves notification emails (verification, etc.) queued but never sent, since delivery happens in the separate worker process.
